dataStores.name: Primary RDBMS
dataStores.purpose: System of record for tenants, users, documents metadata, version index, scope mappings, sync cursors, subscriptions, AI-review decisions.
accessPatterns: Row-Level Security policies bind queries to the active tenant_id
Read replicas serve Portal API hot reads
Primary handles writes from Publishing Pipeline + Auth + Notification
dataStores.scalingStrategy: Aurora Serverless v2 ACUs scale automatically; read replicas added per environment based on load tests.

dataStores.name: Content Blob Store
dataStores.technology: Amazon S3 (Object Lock enabled, versioning ON)
dataStores.purpose: Immutable rendered HTML per (document, version); generated PDFs (with TTL); original Confluence storage-format snapshots for audit.
accessPatterns: Write-once at publish time; never modified
Read via pre-signed URLs (short TTL) from Portal API
Lifecycle: hot bucket → IA after 90 days for older versions
dataStores.scalingStrategy: S3 elastic; no operational scaling work.

dataStores.name: Search Index
dataStores.purpose: Full-text search index of all published document versions, scoped per tenant via a non-overridable filter at the search-gateway.
accessPatterns: Tenant filter injected at gateway; callers cannot bypass
dataStores.scalingStrategy: Multi-AZ with auto-tune; capacity sized per load tests; shard per tenant family.

dataStores.name: Cache + Sessions
dataStores.purpose: Active sessions, rate-limit counters, per-user last-visited, hot document version render cache.
accessPatterns: Sessions: read on every authenticated request
Render cache: read-through; invalidation event on publish-complete
dataStores.scalingStrategy: Cluster mode with read replicas; sized per p95 throughput targets.

dataStores.name: Audit Ledger
dataStores.purpose: Tamper-evident append-only audit log for authentication, document view, admin action, AI review decision, sync re-trigger, unpublish.
accessPatterns: Write on every audit-relevant event via Audit Service
Read constrained to security + admin roles
dataStores.scalingStrategy: QLDB managed; cold-archive to S3 with Object Lock after 12 months.

dataArchitecture.dataFlowDescription: Sync flow: Confluence webhook → Lambda receiver verifies HMAC and enqueues into SQS publish-queue → Publishing Pipeline (Step Functions) pulls one event → applies allow-list + approval state → calls AI Gateway for document review → on clean review, renders HTML and writes the immutable blob to S3, the metadata row to Aurora, the search document to OpenSearch, and emits publish-complete on EventBridge → Notification Service consumes the event and assembles per-user digests. Read flow: client request hits CloudFront → Next.js Frontend (Fargate) → session validated via Auth Service → Portal API queries Aurora read replica for metadata, fetches the HTML blob from S3 (or Redis render cache), returns to the user. Per-user last-visited is written-behind to Postgres via Redis. Audit flow: every audit-relevant action across services emits an audit-event on EventBridge → Audit Service writes to QLDB. Daily integrity verification compares the QLDB digest against the prior recorded digest and pages security on mismatch.
dataArchitecture.cachingStrategy: Three layers: CloudFront edge (cache-key includes tenant_id from auth context — done via Lambda@Edge so cross-tenant cache poisoning is impossible); Redis read-through cache for hot document versions and rendered HTML (TTL 1h, invalidated on publish-complete); Aurora read replicas absorb metadata reads. Cache invalidation on publish-complete is pushed to both CloudFront and Redis simultaneously.
dataArchitecture.dataRetention: Document versions: last 20 retained per page in hot S3 storage; older versions metadata-only in Aurora with content garbage-collected. Audit log: ≥ 12 months in QLDB, then cold-archived to S3 Object-Lock-Compliance for the contractual retention window. Sessions: TTL bound to the session-timeout configuration. Last-visited per user: retained for the user's lifetime; erased on user removal.

apiDesign.pattern: REST + Server-Sent Events for live progress (publish status in Admin UI); JSON over HTTPS; OpenAPI 3.1 specs versioned with services.
conventions: All client-facing endpoints are HTTPS only, TLS 1.2+, HSTS 1-year
All endpoints carry an x-request-id; logs and audit join on this ID
Error responses follow RFC 7807 Problem Details
Mutation endpoints require an Idempotency-Key header
apiDesign.requestResponseFormat: application/json (UTF-8) with explicit schemaVersion field on every payload.

integrationContracts.purpose: Source of truth; provides page content and change events.
integrationContracts.protocol: HTTPS REST (Confluence Cloud REST v2) + webhook callbacks
integrationContracts.authentication: OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant; rotating tokens stored in AWS Secrets Manager
integrationContracts.errorHandling: Retry with exponential backoff on 5xx and 429; fail-closed (do not publish) on persistent error; dead-letter queue for poison events.

integrationContracts.purpose: All AI functions: review, release notes, summaries, notifications, quality scoring.
integrationContracts.protocol: AWS SDK / Bedrock Runtime InvokeModel + ConverseStream
integrationContracts.authentication: IAM role with least-privilege Bedrock InvokeModel on the configured Claude model ARN(s)
integrationContracts.errorHandling: Fail closed: any Bedrock 5xx, timeout, or response-schema-mismatch causes the AI Gateway to return a structured 'provider-unavailable' error; pipeline halts the publish.

integrationContracts.purpose: Send notification emails (digest and breaking-change) and operational mail (invitations, password reset).
integrationContracts.authentication: IAM role with SES SendEmail on the docs.wsd.com identity
integrationContracts.errorHandling: Retry transient throttling; dead-letter to SQS for manual investigation on persistent failure; bounces and complaints feed back to Notification Service to suppress affected addresses.

integrationContracts.purpose: SAML 2.0 / OIDC SSO mediation for client tenants requiring enterprise login.
integrationContracts.authentication: WorkOS API key in AWS Secrets Manager
integrationContracts.errorHandling: Surface a generic 'SSO unavailable' error to the user; fall back to support contact, never to password login on a SSO-enabled tenant.

messagingPatterns: EventBridge for cross-service domain events (publish-complete, audit-event, user-disabled)
SQS for ordered work-queues (publish-queue, notification-queue, dead-letter queues per consumer)
Step Functions for the publishing pipeline state machine (visibility + retry semantics)

eventDrivenArchitecture.eventBus: Amazon EventBridge (default + dedicated bus per env)
